data.title: Svätý Jur – Neštich in 3D, a mighty Slavic hillfort
data.excerpt: The hillfort of Neštich at Svätý Jur is among the most important and the mightiest Slavic hillforts in Slovakia. Jakub Španiel has created a very striking visualisation of how it may have looked at the end of the 9th century, with 3D lidar data provided by Tibor Lieskovský.
